item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and its nearby context, then call out concrete issues.

`test/orders.js` exports basic shop-order helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price × qty`.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: divides order total by item count.
- `formatOrder(order)`: produces item lines and a discounted total.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` has an off-by-one loop condition: `i <= items.length` accesses `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'price')`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, `calcTotal([])` also throws instead of returning `0`.
- `averageItemPrice([])` would be invalid even after fixing `calcTotal`, since it divides by zero (`NaN`).
- `averageItemPrice` may be semantically wrong if “item” means individual units: it divides by number of line items, rather than total quantity.
